description.narrative: Insatsen ger stöd till Utrikespolitiska Institutet att öppna European Policy Institute in Kyiv (EPIK), en tankesmedja med fokus på Ukraina, policyutveckling.
The intervention provides support to the Swedish Institute of International Affairs to establish the European Policy Institute in Kyiv (EPIK), a policy-focused think tank dedicated to Ukraine.

The objective of this intervention is to establish the European Think Tank Office (ETTO) in Kyiv as a fully functional and recognised policy hub that contributes to evidence-based policy in and together with Ukraine and EU. ETTO will focus on themes such as geopolitics, security and stabilisation, EU accession and related reforms, conflict and post-conflict environments, reconstruction, inclusive economic development, and human rights.
The intervention aims to strengthen the capacity for policy analysis in, about, and with Ukraine by engaging Ukrainian and international expertise in a joint platform. ETTO intends to produce high-quality, accessible policy analysis with the purpose to inform national and international policy processes, particularly in support of Ukraine's EU accession and reform agenda.
ETTO has the intention to become a recognised actor in the European policy ecosystem, contributing to improved coherence between EU and Ukrainian policies and reform implementation.
Through publications, convenings, and collaboration with Ukrainian partners, ETTO will strengthen the policy-making environment and contribute to long-term development outcomes such as improved governance, enhanced rule of law, and inclusive, sustainable recovery. The ultimate goal is to improve the livelihoods and rights of Ukrainian and Eastern European citizens by contributing to better policies and reform implementation.
